serialization: native C ABI byte slice and uint32_t
ownership: caller retains input and output storage
endianness: scalar decimal parse is endian independent
alignment: C compiler ABI for uint32_t output
containment: no callback or unwind crosses ABI
cancellation: not applicable within one bounded call
retry: caller may retry only with corrected immutable input
version_negotiation: MNCS_PARSER_ABI must equal generated binding version
malformed_input: non-decimal, empty, null, oversized, and range cases reject
